sbh2.3:1.4: having established the benevolent intention, [it is] the resolve to bring mild, middling, or strong happiness —
sbh2.3:1.5: [a resolve] grounded in the concentrated plane.
sbh2.3:1.9: The benevolent intention and the resolve to bring happiness, grounded in the concentrated plane — this is the apprehending [mind].
sbh2.3:1.11: and the apprehending [mind], combined into one — this is called lovingkindness.
sbh2.3:2.1: When it first says 'with mind imbued with lovingkindness,' by this the benevolent intention toward the three sides — friend, enemy, neutral — is expressed.
sbh2.3:2.3: 'without enmity, [Conjectural: without opposition], without harming' — by this, the threefold characteristic of that benevolent intention is expressed.
sbh2.3:2.4: Of these: by non-enmity, the benevolent intention [is characterized]. This non-enmity is expressed by two further terms:
sbh2.3:2.6: [Conjectural: Non-opposition]: in the sense of standing in a non-adversarial state.
sbh2.3:2.7: Non-harming: in the sense of [Conjectural: not wishing] harm.
sbh2.3:3.2: 'vast, exalted, [Conjectural: immeasurable]' — by this, the bringing of mild, middling, or strong happiness is expressed:
sbh2.3:3.3: happiness of the desire-realm, or of the first-and-second-absorption planes, or of the third-absorption plane.
sbh2.3:3.5: 'having resolved, [Conjectural: having pervaded], he attains and abides' — by this, the resolve to bring happiness, grounded in the concentrated plane, is expressed.
sbh2.3:4.1: This bringing of happiness, encompassed by the benevolent intention,
sbh2.3:4.4: should be understood as directed toward those who are neither-suffering-nor-happy, desiring happiness, on the friend-side, enemy-side, or neutral-side.
sbh2.3:4.5: Whereas for the one who is suffering, or the [Conjectural: happy] one, on the friend-side,
sbh2.3:4.7: the suffering one is the object of compassion;
sbh2.3:4.8: the happy one is the object of sympathetic joy. This is called lovingkindness.
sbh2.3:5.1: Here, the ill-will-conduct person, cultivating lovingkindness, attenuates the ill-will toward beings.
sbh2.3:5.2: He purifies the mind from ill-will.
